neighbours.label: ' parts' meaning territorial portions of a country or region (ruled parts of Estonia, other parts of Africa), vs parts of objects or works, and regions/areas in the same frame
fire: For two centuries Sweden controlled parts of what is now Finland.
The holiday is celebrated in other parts of Europe with bonfires.
Monsoon rains have flooded parts of Bangladesh this week.
The empire once ruled parts of North Africa and Spain.
Wolves have returned to parts of Germany after a long absence.
Tea is grown in many parts of Kenya on steep hillsides.
Two lawmakers who represent parts of Denver wrote the new bill.
Malaria is still common in parts of Central America.
quiet: For two centuries Sweden controlled the trade routes of the Baltic.
The holiday is celebrated in other regions of Europe with bonfires.
The mechanic had to order spare parts for the old tractor.
Some parts of the novel drag, but the ending is wonderful.
Wolves have returned to Germany after a long absence.
Tea is grown on steep hillsides across Kenya.
Two lawmakers from Denver wrote the new bill together.
The kit comes with all the parts you need to build the shelf.

predictions: 'parts of <place>' 0.4-0.8; spare parts, parts of a film, and 'regions of <place>' under 0.15.
notes: Card: ' parts' x21, all 'parts of <country/region>'.
